title: Zakhmi Hua Jo
body:
zakhmi hua jo sajde may damaad e mustafa
ek hashr sa namaziyon may ho gaya bapa
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se chale hussain o hassan sar ko peet'te
ek tehelka sa khaana e ismat may pad gaya
zakhmi hua jo sajde...
<<DIVIDER>>
pahunche ali ke laal jo masjid may doston
dekha ke khoon may doobe huwe hai shahe huda
zakhmi hua jo sajde...
<<DIVIDER>>
al qissa shaahzade chale le ke baap ko
ghar ke qareeb pahunche wo maula ne ye kaha
zakhmi hua jo sajde...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahle haram ke rone ki awaaz aayegi
ab doston ko saath se kar do al-hida
zakhmi hua jo sajde...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar may ali ko laaye jo zehra ke naunehal
saydaniyon ko fart e alam se ghash aagaya
zakhmi hua jo sajde...
<<DIVIDER>>
talwaar zehr may bujhi aisi lagayi thi
jis se ali ko chain koi dam na aata tha
zakhmi hua jo sajde...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzre isi tarha se musibat may teen roz
ekkeeswi shab aayi to mehshar hua bapa
zakhmi hua jo sajde...
